name: caption-karaoke
title: Caption Karaoke
description: Each word fills with color left to right exactly as it is spoken, with the whole phrase readable before the voice reaches it.
useWhen: A voiceover or talking head needs captions and the viewer should be able to read ahead: the full phrase is on screen and the fill only shows where the voice is.
The pace of speech is part of the point: a slow word fills slowly and a quick one snaps.
avoidWhen: There is no voiceover and the text is scripted: use word-stream, which paces phrases on its own.
You want letters typed out on their own clock: use typewriter.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Captions
variables.description: Word timings as JSON: [{"text","startMs","endMs"}] in milliseconds, or [{"text","start","end"}] in seconds. A transcript from Mosio works as is.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Caption text size in pixels (at 1080 px on the short side).

variables.label: Page window
variables.description: Words that start within this window share one page of captions. A sentence end always starts a new page.

variables.label: Hold
variables.description: How long the last page stays after its final word.

variables.label: Shadow
variables.description: Soft shadow behind the text for legibility on footage.

variables.label: Fill color
variables.description: Color the word fills with as it is spoken.
